opening.argument: The presentation leads with a 600-plus FTM and tenfold-return claim, advertising a flash-loan arbitrage trading bot as a route to substantial profits. It then turns that claim into a participation flow: viewers are instructed to deploy a contract, fund it with cryptocurrency, send FTM to the deployed contract, and execute the flash loan. The speaker confirms that the contract must be supplied with enough gas to trade, describes the transaction as deployed to the blockchain, and characterizes the process as currently working, easy, and fast. Although the description includes a general warning about flash-loan exploits, that warning does not change the central offer: the claimed return is tied to sending cryptocurrency into a deployed contract and carrying out the instructed transaction.

citations.quote: Huge Profits! (600+ FTM +) FANTOM Flash Loan Arbitrage Trading Bot | 10X with FTM Flash Loan
Send FTM to the deployed contract to initiate the swap
Now I need to supply this contract slash coin with enough gas to be able to arbitrage trade back and forth with itself.
Eventually, these decks will make it so we can't do this. But it's working now, guys. And I mean, it's sweet. It's easy. It's fast.
